values.value: Hey, while I was walking the perimeter I noticed a few patches in the front yard that look like early gray-leaf spot — pretty common in St. Augustine here in central Florida this time of year. Untreated it can spread fast in a wet season. Our Lawn Service plan covers fungicide rotations, fertilization, and weed control on a six-week cycle. Want me to grab a quote before I leave? I can flag it for our lawn agronomist — no pressure.
